cd /dayjs && cat > test/plugin/tmpmer.test.js <<'EOF'
import moment from 'moment'
import dayjs from '../../src'
import customParseFormat from '../../src/plugin/customParseFormat'
import '../../src/locale/zh-cn'
import '../../src/locale/ja'

dayjs.extend(customParseFormat)

describe('meridiem locale', () => {
  it('AM', () => {
    const input = '2018-05-02 上午 12:00'
    const format = 'YYYY-MM-DD A hh:mm'
    expect(dayjs(input, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf()).toBe(moment(input, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf())
    const input2 = '2018-05-02 上午 09:00'
    expect(dayjs(input2, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf()).toBe(moment(input2, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf())
  })
  it('PM', () => {
    const input = '2018-05-02 下午 12:00'
    const format = 'YYYY-MM-DD A hh:mm'
    expect(dayjs(input, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf()).toBe(moment(input, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf())
    const input2 = '2018-05-02 下午 09:00'
    expect(dayjs(input2, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf()).toBe(moment(input2, format, 'zh-cn').valueOf())
  })
  it('ja', () => {
    const format = 'YYYY-MM-DD A hh:mm'
    const a = '2018-05-02 午前 09:00'
    const b = '2018-05-02 午後 09:00'
    expect(dayjs(a, format, 'ja').valueOf()).toBe(moment(a, format, 'ja').valueOf())
    expect(dayjs(b, format, 'ja').valueOf()).toBe(moment(b, format, 'ja').valueOf())
  })
  it('en still works', () => {
    const input = '2018-05-02 12:00 am'
    const format = 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm a'
    expect(dayjs(input, format).valueOf()).toBe(moment(input, format).valueOf())
    const input2 = '2018-05-02 12:00 PM'
    const format2 = 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm A'
    expect(dayjs(input2, format2).valueOf()).toBe(moment(input2, format2).valueOf())
  })
})
EOF
